caption.text: The beast hits the street with Warpaint on repeat.

levels.setting: Gray, icy daytime city full of binocular ghosts. Andrew joins at a night picnic by a lake, then the rest of the level is at night (dark: true from that point).

ghostFirstSeenCaption.text: Their eyes are everywhere. Always watching. Their ears always open. Always listening.

andrewJoinScene.description: Night. A blanket by the lake, a bottle of wine, a loaf of bread. Andrew is sitting there. He stands up and joins her.

caption.text: A trip to the art museum and then some wine, bread and a lake at night.
A message from a guy as jet lagged as you.

endCaption.text: Against your best judgement, you stuck around for a bit.

outfit.paletteNote: Picked by Claude Code overnight. Slots: C dress, c rim, P belt and hat band, K hat.

levels.setting: Big, busy, colorful city. Crowds, food stalls, music, elevated train tracks as platforms. Warm colors after the gray.

caption.text: Big city, big energy, everyone welcome. Finally.

outfit.paletteNote: Picked by Claude Code overnight. Slots: C dress, c rim, P belt and hat band, K hat.

levels.setting: Henry Street. Strung lanterns, fire escapes, storefront signs, a dumpling shop across the street from home.

startCaption.text: New York. You finally made it. Only a small detour.

caption.text: Henry Street. Dumplings across the street, any time you like. (Never)

rabbitSendoffCaption.text: Rupert got the life he deserved.

skill.text: A whole new kind of love

outfit.paletteNote: Picked by Claude Code overnight. Slots: C dress, c rim, P belt and hat band, K hat.

startCaption.text: One year. Seven countries. One baby.

segments.setting: Jungle cenote: a short underwater swim section. A corrupt cop blocks the path. When Jasmin reaches him, Andrew steps forward, pays the bribe, and grumbles; the cop steps aside. Jasmin does nothing.

stampCaption.text: Cenotes by morning. Mordidas by night.

segments.setting: Green mountain valley (El Valle), then the Panama City skyline.

stampCaption.text: El Valle, then the big city. Shawarma on fleek.

segments.setting: Most detailed segment. Giant tortoises as slow moving platforms, sea lions sunbathing on rocks, black iguanas. Tim (friend visiting from Seattle) appears as a cameo NPC.

stampCaption.text: Tortoises, sea lions, swimming iguanas and a mean old visitor.

segments.setting: Valparaiso: a vertical climb up a hillside packed with colorful houses. A beautiful home at the top.

stampCaption.text: A house on a hill made of houses.

segments.setting: A cold, beautiful city and a beautiful apartment, but hazards everywhere: cold snaps, germ clouds, bad food (enemies are food and germs, never people). Ends in the wine mountains at a candlelit hut, where a short cutscene plays: Andrew proposes again.

stampCaption.text: Cold, sick, and badly fed. Still the best place to ask you again.

proposalCaption.text: I asked again. You said yes again.

segments.setting: Relief. Warm colors, beaches, food stalls, friendly crowds. Easiest segment.

stampCaption.text: Brazil. Warm again, fed again, saved.

outfit.paletteNote: Picked by Claude Code overnight. Slots: C dress, c rim, P belt and hat band, K hat.

levels.setting: Chocolate Factory Lofts: chocolate bar platforms, big loft windows. Isaac's school is part of the level: a backpack collectible and a school building in the background.

startCaption.text: Back in the city but across the river.

nubeJoinCaption.text: The newborn haze and clouds part and Nube arrives.

startCaption.text: New year. New building. What could go wrong?

bossIntroCaption.text: Fire number three. Not on our watch. (If you count the oven fire)

bossDefeatedCaption.text: Out. Everyone is safe. Minor roof damage.

inventoryTitle.text: Everything you picked up along the way

namePrompt.text: Only you can decide what’s next! The world is your mollusk.

jenniferCaption.text: Jennifer stays an egg. Some things are already perfect.

credits.text: Super Jasmin World 3: A New Magic
Co-starring Isaac, Aya, Nube, and Jennifer the egg.
Special guest: Tim, all the way from Seattle.
Rupert, happy in his new home.
Happy birthday. I am so proud of your journey. I love you.
